**PUBLIC RESPONSE:**  
Immediate use only (BUD of 0 h; discard remainder at once).  

The round-1 responses have clarified the decisive point: USP <797> (single-dose container section) explicitly separates ampules from resealable single-dose vials. Snapping the neck converts the ampule into an irreversible open system with continuous, unprotected environmental exposure and no mechanism for closure or protection. Consequently, even inside an ISO 5 sterile field the chapter mandates immediate use of the entire contents; any unused portion must be discarded and no storage interval or BUD is permitted.  

The 4 h (or 1 h/6 h) positions conflate ampules with either low-risk CSP timing tables or the vial-specific 6 h allowance that applies only to containers that remain closed after initial entry. Those allowances do not override the ampule-specific rule. The question’s phrasing (“from the time of puncture in a sterile environment”) therefore triggers the strict immediate-use requirement for this container type.
